# BoostPilot AI

BoostPilot AI is an AI-powered content optimization platform for creators, marketers, freelancers, agencies, and social media teams.

Website:
https://boostpilotai.vercel.app

## What BoostPilot AI Does

BoostPilot AI analyzes uploaded images and videos and generates platform-ready content suggestions.

The platform helps users:

* Generate captions
* Generate hooks
* Generate hashtags
* Improve content quality
* Optimize content for specific platforms
* Analyze media quality
* Create export-ready reports
* Generate AI rewrites
* Discover content trends
* Get creator growth suggestions
* Save reusable content
* Generate YouTube thumbnail concepts

## Core Features

### AI Content Analysis

Analyze:

* Images
* Videos
* Social media creatives
* Marketing assets

Outputs include:

* Captions
* Hooks
* Hashtags
* Content summaries
* Improvement suggestions
* Platform-fit recommendations
* Quality scores

### AI Rewrite Studio

Generate:

* Shorter captions
* Longer captions
* Viral-style rewrites
* Professional rewrites
* Platform-specific rewrites
* Call-to-action improvements

### Trend Finder

Discover:

* Trending topics
* Trending content ideas
* Platform-specific opportunities
* Niche suggestions
* Content inspiration

### Growth Coach

Receive:

* Content strategy recommendations
* Audience growth suggestions
* Posting improvements
* Creator workflow guidance
* Performance recommendations

### Content Library

Store and reuse:

* Captions
* Hooks
* Hashtags
* Titles
* Rewritten content
* Saved reports

### AI Media Enhancer

Improve media using:

* Platform cropping
* Safe margins
* Composition adjustments
* Visibility improvements
* Social-media readiness checks

### Thumbnail Studio

Generate:

* Thumbnail ideas
* Thumbnail concepts
* Thumbnail text suggestions
* Creator-style thumbnail variations

## Supported Platforms

BoostPilot AI supports:

* YouTube
* Instagram
* Facebook
* LinkedIn
* Twitter/X

### Creators

Content creators can:

Agencies can:

Freelancers can:

* Improve client deliverables

## Pricing Plans

### Free

Includes:

* Basic AI analysis
* Basic captions
* Basic hooks
* Limited monthly analyses

### Creator

Includes:

* AI Rewrite Studio
* Content Library
* No watermark
* Increased monthly usage

### Pro

Includes:

* Trend Finder
* Growth Coach
* Advanced creator tools
* Higher monthly usage limits

### Agency

Includes:

* Everything in Pro
* Team-ready workflows
* Priority processing
* Agency-focused tools
